anomaly_label: Jumpy heater (H702, H706, H704, H708) power

evidence.observation: Reboiler temperature was 348.3 °C after a gradual rise from 345.7 °C at run start.
T701 abruptly rose to 360.8 °C while PDI702 increased from 2.0 to 5.7 mbar and PY23 fell from 298.5 to 293.9 mbar.

T701 rose further to 381.4 °C while T702 declined to 52.9 °C; PDI702 remained elevated at 5.0 mbar and PY23 was 296.6 mbar. The coupled temperature and pressure changes indicate an execution anomaly but do not identify a specific fault.

args.missing_evidence: Protocol temperature and pressure setpoints, permitted transitions and safety limits; independent reboiler temperature verification, heater output, and pressure-path checks to distinguish actual process upset from sensor error. No composition measurement or separation target is provided.
